dataset.dataset_robot_type_warning: metadata says so100_follower; do not assume SO-101 mechanical identity without calibration evidence

lerobot_source_evidence.current_config: src/lerobot/robots/so_follower/config_so_follower.py:use_degrees=True (current default; documented as backward compatibility with previous policies/datasets)
lerobot_source_evidence.later_change: v0.3.2 (2025-08-01) introduced use_degrees=False as the SO100 default, after this dataset was created

unit_evidence.manipulator.py:294-297: Rotations are expressed in degrees in nominal range of [-180, 180], and linear motions (like gripper of Aloha) in nominal range of [0, 100].
unit_evidence.feetech_calibration.py:490: Joints with rotational motions are expressed in degrees in nominal range of [-180, 180].
unit_evidence.later_change: LeRobot v0.3.2 (2025-08-01) introduced use_degrees=False as the SO100 default; the current default True is documented as backward compatibility with previous policies/datasets.

dataset_provenance.same_body_reason: metadata says so100_follower; public elbow/wrist reach 100/99.49 degrees and exceed the SO-101 XML limits; the dataset does not include its calibration file.

decision.reason: metadata says so100_follower; public elbow_flex/wrist_flex reach 100.0/99.49 degrees and exceed the SO-101 XML upper limits (96.83/95.01 degrees) by 3.17/4.49 degrees; the dataset does not include its calibration file.
decision.allowed_use: carrier smoke test only, with an explicit degree->radian and gripper adapter; count and report every clip event.
decision.not_allowed_use: same-body SO-101 training/evaluation, or attributing A100/VLA failures to TPSC before the interface is resolved.
required_before_tpsc: collect project-owned SO-101 demonstrations with the project's calibration and record the calibration file/revision
or obtain a public dataset that declares robot_type=so101_follower and includes calibration metadata
re-run this audit with the actual calibration range, not a range-matching assumption

required_adapter: Record the dataset-era degree convention (created 2025-05-23, before LeRobot v0.3.2) and re-check it for any newer dataset.
Convert the first five public joint values from degrees to radians.
Map the public gripper 0..100 convention to the scene hinge range; do not pass it as radians.
Do not silently clip elbow_flex/wrist_flex; count and report any clip events.
Resolve the SO-100 vs SO-101 body/calibration mismatch before claiming same-body simulation; prefer project-owned SO-101 data for TPSC.
limitations: Degree values are relative to the dataset's own calibration; without the calibration file they do not identify the project SO-101 zero/range.
The public dataset is a SO-100 carrier (metadata), not a same-body SO-101 dataset.
Range conversion does not prove kinematic or dynamic equivalence.
The public dataset contains one task_index only; it is a carrier smoke-test asset, not the TPSC task matrix.
No weights were loaded and no policy action was executed.
